kebab_example: aliyun pailangstudio create-deployment --workspace-id 47800 --accessibility PRIVATE --resource-type Flow --resource-id flow-asdf000000123 --resource-snapshot-id snap-asfg000000123 --service-name myservice01 --description This_is_description --enable-trace true --chat-history-config ConnectionName=rdsconnection StorageType=RDS --work-dir oss://mybucket.oss-cn-hangzhou-internal.aliyuncs.com/workdir/ --content-moderation-config EnableInputModeration=true EnableOutputModeration=true StreamingModerationThreshold=5 --deployment-config metadata_:_name_:_langstudio_20260000003848_jro7_,_instance_:1,_workspace_id_:_285000_,_enable_webservice_:false_,_cloud_:_computing_:_instances_:_type_:_ecs.g7.xlarge_,_networking_:_vpc_id_:_vpc-bp1obprt0000004bzo00d_,_vswitch_id_:_vsw-bp1p6i36k000000pmfhw8_,_security_group_id_:_sg-bp1djud4000000zecl5a --auto-approval true --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDeployment

parameters.help_en:
The visibility of the workspace. Valid values:
PRIVATE: The workspace is visible only to you and administrators.
PUBLIC: The workspace is visible to all users
parameters.help_zh:
工作空间可见性，可能值为：
PRIVATE：在此工作空间中，仅对您和管理员可见。
PUBLIC：在此工作空间中，对所有人可见
parameters.name: accessibility

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically skip the deployment confirmation step
parameters.help_zh: 是否自动跳过部署确认环节
parameters.name: auto_approval

fields.help_en: The connection name. This parameter is required when the chat history storage method is set to RDS
fields.help_zh: 连接名称。对话历史存储方式为RDS的时候需要指定该参数
fields.name: connection_name

fields.help_en:
The storage method. Valid values:
LOCAL: Chat history is saved in a local SQLite file. Multi-instance deployment is not supported.
OSS: Chat history is saved in a specific path under the OSS working directory of the service.
RDS: Chat history is saved in an ApsaraDB RDS table. An ApsaraDB RDS connection must be specified
fields.help_zh:
存储方式。取值：
LOCAL: 对话历史保存在本地SQLite文件，不支持多实例的部署方式。
OSS：对话历史保存在服务OSS工作路径下特定的路径下。
RDS：对话历史保存在RDS的表中，需要指定一个RDS连接
fields.name: storage_type

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable security moderation for input content
fields.help_zh: 是否启用对输入的安全审查
fields.name: enable_input_moderation

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable content moderation for output content
fields.help_zh: 是否启用对输出的内容审查
fields.name: enable_output_moderation

fields.help_en: The cache size for streaming output moderation. Default value: 5
fields.help_zh: 流式输出内容送审缓存大小，默认为5
fields.name: streaming_moderation_threshold

parameters.help_en: The deployment configuration. For more information, see Deployment configuration (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/pai/user-guide/parameters-of-model-services) of PAI-EAS
parameters.help_zh: 部署配置。具体参考PAI-EAS的部署配置 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pai/user-guide/parameters-of-model-services)
parameters.name: deployment_config

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether Tracing Analysis is enabled
parameters.name: enable_trace

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource to be deployed
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The snapshot ID of the resource to be deployed. If this parameter is provided, the system deploys the resource directly based on the snapshot. If this parameter is not provided, the system creates a new snapshot for the resource before deployment
parameters.help_zh: 待部署资源的快照 ID。若提供该参数，系统将直接基于该快照进行部署；若未提供，系统会先为资源创建新快照，再执行部署
parameters.name: resource_snapshot_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource to be deployed. Valid values:
Flow: workflow project
Code: code-mode project
parameters.help_zh:
待部署的资源类型。取值：
Flow: 工作流的项目
Code: 代码模式的项目
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the service. Format requirements:
Only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_) are supported.
Must start with a letter.
Must be 1 to 45 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
服务名字。格式要求：
支持小写字母、数字和下划线
必须以字母开头
长度1-45个字符
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en: The OSS working directory of the service. It is used to store runtime logs and chat history of the service
parameters.help_zh: 服务的OSS工作目录。用于存储服务的运行日志、对话历史等
parameters.name: work_dir

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. For more information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

DeploymentId.description_en: The ID of the deployment record
